series.description: Sophia, an Omega, finds out her boy friend Bruce cheated with her bestie Louisa, before her eighteenth birthday. But soon, she finds out Bruce's brother Bryan, the Alpha, is her destined mate. It is on Bryan's engagement banquet, and her words ruin it. Bryan is furious and sacks her brother, which causes her mother to get sick. To save her family, Sophia becomes his personal secretary. He is cold to her, yet his wolf longs for her. After conflicts and crises, they forge real feelings and form a real mate bond.

Hilwyn, a noble healer who despises aristocratic constraints, treats King Lucien for a chronic poisoning that has been mistaken for impotence. To protect his secret and avoid marriage pressure, Lucien proposes a contractual marriage, eighty thousand gold coins, no interference, and separate lives. But their constant bickering masks an unexpected bond. As Hilwyn risks everything to detoxify him and proves her skill before the royal court, Lucien moves from cold indifference to possessive devotion. When he tears up their contract and confesses his heart, Hilwyn must choose between her hard-won independence and a love she never anticipated...

series.seriesName: Left at the Altar, Married Power
series.description: Linsey was overjoyed to marry her fiancé Felix, until he was called away by a single phone call from that homewrecker. Humiliated at her own wedding, Linsey hit rock bottom. Then the homewrecker called again, just to gloat. But Linsey didn't cry. She turned around, walked outside the church, and married the first man she saw. As fate would have it, he turned out to be the most powerful man in the city...

series.seriesName: Reborn, She Let Her Sister Marry The Bastard
series.description: Betrayed and killed by fiancé Damian and stepsister Vivian, Scarlett is reborn with past memories, dumps the scumbag and enters a contract marriage with cold heir Ethan for revenge. They find Damian is their shared enemy, team up with also-reborn Vivian, collect his crime evidence, bring him to justice after life-or-death tests and turn their fake marriage into real love.

In his past life, Eric fell hard for Vera, only for her to conspire with Nigel to lure him with rich, indulgent food and kill him by exploiting his diabetes. Moments before his death, Caroline confessed her feelings for him. Reborn, Eric exposes Vera and Nigel's scheme, confesses his love to Caroline, and makes the pair pay for their betrayal.

Callie was married to Andrew for three years, during which she played the dutiful wife, attending to his every need, yet failed to warm his heart.When Andrew's idealized first love falsely accused Callie, he even demanded she donate a kidney to compensate his beloved.Realizing the futility, Callie handed him the divorce papers, freeing him to be with his first love.Andrew thinks that Kerri can't even live without him.However, the very next day, Callie made headlines as the heiress of the prestigious Jon family.When they met again after the divorce, Andrew was filled with regret as he looked at the radiant Callie.It was then that he realized that he had fallen in love with her. But will he ever be able to get her back?

Intangible cultural heritage cheongsam master Luke exhausted his heart and soul for his fiancée Willow and generated $1.8 million in annual revenue. His mother fell critically ill and urgently needed $200,000 for surgery, yet Willow refused to give a single cent and publicly humiliated him by calling him just a tailor. With his heart broken, Luke left with nothing to start his own business alone. He turned the tables with his lost cheongsam sewing skills and joined hands with cheongsam inheritor Ailany to compete in the international contest, making those who once looked down on him unable to reach his heights now.

Zephyr was the heir of Drakonhold. But three years ago, his father was murdered, and he became a slave. When he was abused, his father's legacy showed, granting him the ability to cultivate power by taking hits. The bullies beat him, but he crushed them all and got stronger and stronger. He was ready to avenge his family and save his sister.

Alan is a legendary mech pilot. Ten years ago, he hurt the Hive Mother and pushed back the swarm with his wife Hathaway, but Hathaway died on the battlefield. What's worse, his comrade Danny stole all the credit and framed him for disobeying orders and getting a battalion killed. He worked as a simple mechanic for ten years. When the swarm returns ten years later, legions fell, and Danny escaped from the front line. It's time Alan returns to fight the xenomorphs, and traitors.

In a past life, I was the most courageous general of the dynasty and the least favored princess. To save the scholar laureate who had angered the emperor, I was dispatched to the Yumen Pass, a strategic pass on the empire's border, by my father to fend off the relentless attacks from the Xiongnu. After five years on the frontier, surviving countless brushes with death, I returned to the capital with a broken right arm. The scholar laureate, who once vowed to protect me for life, was now celebrating his wedding. Due to the disgrace of my lost arm, I was sentenced to hang with a ceremonial silk cord. As I hung myself from the rafters, he entered the bridal chamber.

Upon awakening, I found myself back on the day the scholar laureate angered the emperor. Watching my enraged father and the trembling scholar laureate, a cold smile tugged at my lips. If the royal family cannot accommodate me, then I will bring it down!

Fifteen years ago, Evan, a genius boy and heir to the esteemed Bailey family, was taken in by the Harrison family after losing his parents and enduring torment from their son. Luckily, Evan's four stunning aunts—each possessing unique prowess as a powerful warrior, celebrated actress, miracle-working doctor, and successful business tycoon—found him, showering Evan with love. Together, they orchestrated retribution against those who had wronged him.

series.seriesName: The CEO's Wife Is A Secret Boss?!
series.description: Allison Burton intended to disclose her identity and pregnancy via a major project. She found her husband, Jeremy Walsh, with Melanie Russell at a prenatal checkup. After facing her mother-in-law's hostility, she decided to divorce Jeremy. Tragically, her mother-in-law caused her miscarriage. Amidst family conflicts at various events, Jeremy realized his love for Allison and pursued her. He saved her twice, getting injured, which led to their reconciliation.
